individual_outcome_rule: The final pre-outcome protocol must define a single fixed repeat or deterministic final record per episode and policy before reading outcome fields.
reason: The manuscript is fixed at arXiv v1, while the author repository was updated afterwards and currently reports different significance values. Version alignment is selected by publication time and source schema, without per-episode outcome inspection.
release_snapshot_order: Latest repository commit at or before the v1 submission timestamp, if one exists
snapshot_eligibility: Public provenance and schema support the named organic booking repair-policy comparison on the same episodes and prefix. Select the first eligible snapshot before outcome inspection.
target_study: The paper Section10 repair_policies comparison, with located repair, resampling control and the baseline arm; keep the injected live alarm-repair matrix separate.
